Standard: From any condition within the SFE, the air vehicle is capable of sustaining a single engine failure, entering into a power off autorotation, and landing on a level surface from all points outside of the height velocity curve. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess transient air vehicle responses to a sudden engine failure. Evaluate the handling qualities of entering and sustaining a power-off autorotative descent from both forward flight and high altitude hovering flight while maintaining operational limitations. Execute a forced landing to a level surface from outside of the height velocity curve. Perform analysis for each air vehicle configuration and loading. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess transient air vehicle responses to a sudden engine failure. Evaluate the handling qualities of entering and sustaining a power-off autorotative descent from both forward flight and high altitude hovering flight while maintaining operational limitations. Execute a forced landing to a level surface from outside of the height velocity curve. Perform analysis for each air vehicle configuration and loading. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess transient air vehicle responses to a sudden engine failure for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Evaluate the handling qualities of entering and sustaining a power off autorotative descent from both forward flight and high altitude hovering flight while maintaining operational limitations. Execute a forced landing to a level surface from outside of the height velocity curve.
